# AI Assistant & Autonomous Development Guide

AIPanel's AI Agent is deeply integrated with your code editor, git history, database schema, local filesystem, and deployment telemetry.

---

## ⚡ Autonomous Workflow (Gemini & Cursor Style)

Unlike legacy assistants that force constant manual copying or disruptive confirmation dialogues, AIPanel features a frictionless, modern autonomous workflow:

### 1. 🤖 Autonomous Auto-Apply
* **Zero-Click Code Application**: With `⚡ Auto-Apply: ON` enabled in the AI Assistant header, code snippets generated by AI are automatically streamed directly into target editor buffers.
* **Non-Disruptive Notifications**: The code block confirms `✓ Auto-Applied & Saved!` with full visibility into which file was touched.

### 2. 💾 Autonomous Auto-Save & Debounced Disk Synchronization
* **Direct Disk Sync**: Any modification from the AI or user keystrokes is saved directly to disk (`writeFile`) with an 800ms debounce.
* **No Blocking Banners**: Replaces disruptive modal banners with a sleek status badge:
  `✨ AI Modification • ✓ Auto-Saved to Disk • [Show Visual Diff] [Revert (Undo)] [Done]`
* **Instant Revert**: At any time, clicking **`Revert (Undo)`** or pressing `⌘Z` instantly rolls back the file on disk to its exact previous version.
* **Live Status Indicator**: The footer status bar displays real-time disk synchronization (`Auto-Saved`, `Saving...`, `Saved`, `Modified`).

### 3. 🎯 Smart Content-Aware Target File Resolution Engine
* **Mismatched Tab Protection**: AI-generated code will never overwrite an unrelated open file (e.g. pasting package JSON into an open `TASK.md` tab).
* The resolver engine inspects code syntax and AST patterns to route automatically to:
  * **Package Manifests** (`dependencies`, `scripts`, `name`) $\to$ `package.json`
  * **Rust Cargo Manifests** (`[package]`, `[dependencies]`) $\to$ `Cargo.toml`
  * **Containers** (`FROM `, `services:`) $\to$ `Dockerfile` / `docker-compose.yml`
  * **Database SQL** (`CREATE TABLE`, `ALTER TABLE`) $\to$ `schema.sql`
  * **Tasks & Roadmaps** (`- [ ]`, `Tasks`, `Roadmap`) $\to$ `TASK.md`
  * **Architecture Specs** (`# Architecture`) $\to$ `ARCHITECTURE.md`
  * **React Components** (`export default function`, JSX) $\to$ `src/App.tsx`
  * **Styles** (`@tailwind`, CSS rules) $\to$ `src/index.css`

## Supported AI Providers & Models

AIPanel offers flexible AI provider options with zero vendor lock-in:

### 1. Free AI & Fast Prototyping
* **Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (Free)**: Ultra-fast generation with large context window.
* **Kilo Code / OpenRouter Free**: DeepSeek R1 Reasoning Free (`deepseek/deepseek-r1:free`), Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct Free (`meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free`).

### 2. Local Offline AI (Ollama)
* Run models locally via **Ollama** (`qwen2.5-coder:7b`, `llama3.2`, `codellama`, `deepseek-coder`).
* Zero data leaves your machine or private VPC.
* Auto-detects local installed models and provides a custom tag input with 1-click apply.

### 3. High-Speed LPU Cloud
* **Groq LPU (500 T/S)**: `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` running at extreme generation speeds.

### 4. Enterprise SOTA (BYOK)
* **Anthropic**: Claude 3.7 Sonnet / Hybrid Extended Thinking, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Claude 3 Opus.
* **OpenAI**: GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, o3-mini Reasoning, o1 Deep Reasoning.
* **DeepSeek Wholesale**: DeepSeek V3 ($0.14/1M) and DeepSeek R1 ($0.55/1M).

## Interactive Capabilities

### 🔍 Comprehensive Code Audit & Explanation
Ask the assistant to inspect any part of the project:
* *"Audit project security and database indexes"*
* *"Explain how the deployment engine performs atomic symlink switches"*
* *"Verify TypeScript build types across services"*

### 📋 Clean Project Ideation & Auto-Blueprint
* When starting a new blank or idea-driven project, the AI initializes an Ideation Thread comparing **Budget Lean Stack** vs **Enterprise Scalable Stack**, recommending suitable database schemas, and scaffolding `README.md`, `TASK.md`, `TODO.md`, and `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

### 🔄 Changes History & Snapshots
* Every AI edit records an immutable snapshot with timestamp, author, and line diff summary.
* Access the **Changes History Modal** to review past snapshots, perform side-by-side comparisons, or restore previous versions.
